title: MikroScore Knowledge Graph — Study Entity
description: Schema for study entities stored in data/entities/studies/*.json. Studies are first-class KG entities but are hidden from default public graph visualization.

id.description: Canonical study ID. Rules (in priority order): pmid-{PMID} when PMID exists; doi-{normalized-doi} when DOI exists (slashes replaced with dashes); studie-{PMID} is a legacy format that is still accepted.

authors.description: Author string, e.g. 'Smith J, Jones A' or 'Smith J et al.'

url.description: Canonical URL — prefer PubMed when available

summary.description: Neutral data summary (not page-specific editorial framing). Describes what was measured and what was found.

notes: Study entities are locale-neutral — title and summary are in the language of the original paper or in DE/EN as appropriate.
MDX pages control which studies are surfaced and may add short editorial highlights.
The public graph endpoint excludes study nodes by default; they are available to page components on the server side.
